title: Diversity jurisdiction
summary: Diversity jurisdiction permits specified civil actions between parties of different citizenship to be heard in federal court when the statutory conditions are met. The ordinary statute combines citizenship requirements with an amount in controversy.
notes: Article III’s constitutional allowance is not identical to § 1332’s ordinary complete-diversity rule. CAFA and statutory interpleader use different conditions.

sections.Meaning: Diversity jurisdiction permits specified civil actions between parties of different citizenship to be heard in federal court when the statutory conditions are met. The ordinary statute combines citizenship requirements with an amount in controversy.
sections.How to work through the question: Determine the citizenship of every relevant party at the legally relevant time. Apply complete diversity where required, identify the amount genuinely in dispute, and check exceptions and statutory restrictions. Treat corporations, unincorporated entities, natural persons, and foreign parties under their respective rules.
